verification.method: Separate fresh owned 39-migration disposable databases, same helper/runtime/fixture sizes/concurrency; sequential bounded runs on the same constrained Windows desktop. No latency SLO certification or performance improvement inference.

candidate.methodology: 20 samples and 3 warmups per workload; actual JWT/loopback HTTP; numeric-only query events and transparent transaction timing; no p95 pass threshold

workloads.environment: owned disposable loopback PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO + actual Nest HTTP
workloads.transaction_timing_definition: caller-observed scoped transaction elapsed, including queue/commit; transparent delegation, not pure lock hold time
workloads.approved_budget_or_baseline: No approved workload-specific latency SLO; equivalent baseline is recorded separately when executed
